description: Figure 9 is a grouped bar chart illustrating the measured “effect” of context masking perturbations across different linguistic tags for several models, with vertical error bars showing standard deviation. The horizontal axis contains the tag categories labeled (left to right) “case,” “gender,” “tag,” “number,” and “tense,” and the vertical axis is labeled “effect” on a linear scale with tick marks at approximately 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20 (values extending slightly above 20). Each tag category contains six adjacent bars corresponding to the legend entries: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (medium blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red). For “case,” the bars are approximately ~6 (mBERT-L₂), ~5–6 (XLM-L₂), ~2–3 (mBERT-R₂), ~2–3 (XLM-R₂), ~12–13 (mBERT-B₂), and ~11–12 (XLM-B₂), with relatively large error bars especially for the pink and red bars. For “gender,” the bars are smaller, around ~1–2 (light blue), ~1 (medium blue), ~2 (light green), ~1–2 (dark green), ~3–4 (pink), and ~3 (red), each with moderate error bars. For “tag,” the bars are around ~1 (light blue), ~0.5–1 (medium blue), ~1 (light green), ~0.5–1 (dark green), ~4 (pink), and ~3–4 (red), again with visible error bars. For “number,” the bars cluster near ~1 (light blue), ~0.5–1 (medium blue), ~1 (light green), ~0.5–1 (dark green), ~2–3 (pink), and ~2–3 (red), with error bars extending a few units for the pink/red bars. For “tense,” all bars are near zero to about ~1 (light blue ~0.5–1; medium blue ~0–0.5; light green ~0–0.5; dark green ~0–0.5; pink ~0.5–1; red ~0.5–1) with comparatively small error bars. The bars are not shown as explicitly sorted by magnitude; they appear grouped by tag category with a consistent within-group model order matching the legend, and no bars are specially highlighted beyond their distinct colors and the presence of error bars.
